Package com.example.invoicecsv.model

Class InvoiceItem

java.lang.Object
com.example.invoicecsv.model.InvoiceItem

Represents one processed CSV row with its calculated values.

  • Constructor Details

    • InvoiceItem

      public InvoiceItem(String stt, String item, BigDecimal quantity, BigDecimal unitPrice, BigDecimal vatRate, BigDecimal calculatedAmount, BigDecimal calculatedVatAmount)
      Creates a new invoice item.

      Negative values are not rejected by this library because the requirements do not define a negative-value business rule. If a consuming application needs to prohibit them, that should be enforced explicitly in the application layer.

      Parameters:
      stt - the source row number value from the CSV row
      item - the item description
      quantity - the quantity value from the CSV row
      unitPrice - the unit price from the CSV row
      vatRate - the VAT rate from the CSV row
      calculatedAmount - the calculated amount for this row
      calculatedVatAmount - the calculated VAT amount for this row
